rule:
The width of a tread must not be less than the minimum required for this type of building.

Regulatory text (the authoritative clause - use it to interpret the requirement; you must still work out how to read it out of the IFC):
BCA Approved Document (Acceptable Solutions V7.08) - E.3.4 Risers and treads:
E.3.4.2 The width of a tread of a staircase (see Figure E.3.4.2(a) for measurement of “tread”) shall not be less than:
  a) 225 mm, if the staircase is in a residential unit within a residential building;
  b) 250 mm, if the staircase is in an industrial building; or
  c) 275 mm, if the staircase is in any other type of building, including common staircases in a residential building.

This model is a residential building, and all of its staircases are common staircases - none of them sits inside a residential unit. A flight whose tread width is not recorded anywhere in the model cannot be judged: label it ALERT, and do NOT report it as a violation.

Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcStairFlight) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.
notes: Solihin & Eastman class 1. Reference implementation on beta condo_uat1_v1.ifc (residential, split=train): 30 anchor IfcStairFlight elements labelled {'FAIL': 1, 'PASS': 29}.
